stem.en: What did the Chettiars do with their profits?

text.en: Kept all of them locked at home, away from the risks of trade
Put them back into trade, temples, education and welfare
Spent them all on buying land in Burma and in Malaysia
Gave all of them to formal banks to look after for them

explanation.en: The Chettiars reinvested their profits into trade, temples, education and community welfare. Money put back into trade could earn more, and the rest helped their community.

hints.en: The word to remember is reinvested.
